# Locked packages for the CI tests only: no PyTorch, CUDA or transformers (several GB), the tests
# use a fake LLM. Every package, dependencies included, is pinned with the sha256 of its files on
# PyPI: the workflow installs it with --require-hashes --only-binary :all:, so only these exact
# prebuilt wheels can be installed. Resolved for Python 3.11 on Linux (the CI runner).
